body: Pick your fighter: feral about a bridge, plotting something in a ball gown, or winning, quietly. Whichever one is you today, tap Mood and let it pull the Taylor songs that match — then tag the friend who's clearly one of the other two 🤍 longlivets.com/?mode=mood&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mood

altText: Taylor Swift performing the reputation set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a black snake-motif costume under dark green stage lighting.
why: X sibling of the 09-23 Mood beat. Same story-unique campaign + scheduledAt as the IG. Hook: direct address ('pick your fighter'), written as its own compact poll, >20% divergent from the IG (different framing/verbs; only the three verbatim chips are shared, which the calendar requires on both). Chips quoted VERBATIM from mood-starters.ts, all scored-era-safe; no returned songs asserted (chip-poll). Share hook (required on mood): tag-a-friend, grounded. Deep link /?mode=mood verified in code (deepLink.ts:34); caption also says 'tap Mood'. Weighted length ~258 (<270 target), URL counted as 23. PHOTO NOTE: this X carries a photo ONLY because check-drafts.mjs:577 hard-requires X media (2026-09-10) — text-only X, which the calendar/strategy rung 3/L001 all prefer here, is checker-blocked (#3733). Photo = reputation-inglewood-2023: decorative tour tile, NOT the argument (hence mediaEarnsItsPlace 3), distinct photoId from the IG's debut (L001 pair rule), and the freshest-available besides it (5d) — every library photo is now within 6 days, see the IG why for the forced-reuse rationale. photoEra unset (mood non-themed), no era-relevance claim.

critique.rationale: Compact 'pick your fighter' poll on the same three real Mood chips, direct-address, with a genuine tag-a-friend share hook. Drives taps to Mood (the never-shipped feature) via the /?mode=mood deep link; the photo is a decorative reputation-era tile because X now hard-requires media.
